notes.title: The Newest title “Lightracer:The Judge" Unveiled
notes.content:
Dear Amenders,

It's been a while since we last connected. Today, we are thrilled to announce the latest title to the "Lightracer" series by Smartmelon Games: "Lightracer: For Judge."

[previewyoutube=l7ij6M_2VHM;full][/previewyoutube]

The story of this new game is set in a highly advanced dystopian world where you'll take on the role of a judge, making judgments in the midst of intricate and treacherous decisions. You will wield authority to either find solutions or become a part of the administrative machine. Prepare for an epic science fiction saga as well as a civilization epic of seeking hope in dire straits.

"Lightracer: For Judge" is the third title in the "Lightracer" series, promising an unparalleled and profound sci-fi narrative.

In this game, you will encounter life-and-death trials and moral dilemmas. Your choices will determine whether you become a dutiful bureaucrat, a fearless reformer, or even the supreme ruler of civilization. With over 250,000 words of text and multiple endings, the game paints a poignant picture of a civilization struggling to survive over hundreds of years.

The journey through the cosmos is daunting, but we look forward to meeting you again in the future. Your ongoing support means the world to us. 

(Please consider adding the new game to your wishlist. It would mean a lot to us. Thank you!)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3042680/_/

notes.title: Avatar system and the new war system！
notes.content:
Amenders:

The second free DLC 'Stars Will' for 'Lightracer Spark' released on Nov 16th.

In order to provide you with a better gaming experience, the DLC2 "Stars Will", the English version will be postponed to January 2024. Because we are a Chinese Dev team, we will give priority to using Chinese during development, and then ask a professional localization team to process it into English. The localization work for DLC2 was more complicated than expected, so we had to postpone the release of the English version. We will make full use of this time to polish copywriting translation and UI adaptation. We apologize for the inconvenience caused to you. thank you for your support!

But you can now play the following content:

We have reworked the combat system and added a new "AVATAR" system, hoping to make the combat experience more in line with the amenders' expectations.

[h3]Introduction to the avatar system[/h3]
Play as the Amender, descending directly into the world in the form of an avatar, issuing instructions to destroy the enemy or strengthen your own army and jurisdiction.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43121297/2a0d164012fa6d6facde5d8c35ec030526fb484d.png[/img]

[h3]War system remake[/h3]
The version replaces the previous war system, hoping to reduce cumbersome operations and change the overall game experience.
The new version of the war system focuses on the operation of avatars and special troops. The operation methods of the above two are similar to the old version, but they can move forward to any jurisdiction on the same planet without restrictions.
The conventional army will be modified to a control method in the form of issuing orders. You no longer need to directly control each army. Instead, you can assemble the army after choosing a war strategy. The conventional army will complete the combat mission according to your deployment.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43121297/4737974cec97b9784479fd4a907da274841ff574.png[/img]

Four types and more than 30 avatar commands
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43121297/79d56e876f26207906c4d7f6daf21563f6ad3bfd.png[/img]

Three different avatar forms
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43121297/2643f3697f5b28fda114f93ddad4d39f219adc7b.png[/img]

Your avatar can be born from the prologue, so the story of Tien has changed slightly.
Avatars have level settings. After investing basic resources, you can upgrade the level and unlock exclusive instructions for the current form.
Most commands can be upgraded to improve their effectiveness, but require special resources from the warehouse.

To celebrate the release of the new version, the game has launched a limited-time discount this week, interested amenders should not miss it!

notes.title: The development plan for the Lightracer Series.
notes.content:
Dear All Amenders,

We have just finished our exhibition tour at the 2023 World Science Fiction Conference. It is an honor to participate in the world-class sci-fi event and communicate closely with all the great designers and sci-fi fans within this industry, and we would like to express our special gratitude to all Lightracer's players who attended. We are currently continuing to develop our second free-download DLC - Stars Will and will be releasing it within November following our plan. Today we will tell more about the Lightracer series further development plan after the DLC2.

When designing the framework of Lightracer: Spark, we like to maintain the core of stories-telling, while exploring innovative gameplay, to achieve a game experience that combines both TRPG style and strategic gameplay of some sort. Until recently, we have noticed that some parts of our system operations are too cumbersome to help build stories and do not meet our expectations. This problem occurs most obviously at the first release of the base game - Spark. Although we have made efforts to avoid the subsequent DLC1, there are still significant shortcomings in the experience due to the overall game framework.

Now the base game Lightracer: Spark has updated the problems of the combat system that were from the collective feedback. The game sells at $12.99 and is packed with two free DLCs: DLC1 - Grey and Green and DLC2 - Stars Will (released in November) with extended game stories. We have indeed considered providing new content in the form of paid DLC in the future, and we understand that many of you want the story to continue, but based on the shortcomings of the framework mentioned earlier and the current feedback from players, continuing development is feasible but not ideal for the result. New stories will not escape the limits of the old game system, so we would rather start over, spend more time and effort on framework design by learning from the experiences and lessons, and release a new game in the future. We believe in the future, there will be a Lightracer game that has a better gameplay system that fits the core of sci-fi story-telling, we hope to live up to everyone's expectations.

Therefore, DLC2 "Stars Will" will be our last released DLC. Regarding the mobile end of Lightracer: Spark, we are actively coordinating with different channels and distributions, hoping to find suitable partners. The starry sea, a long voyage, we will reunite. Thank you all for your support!

[i]P.S. Come for our free DLC2 in late November![/i]

notes.title: Join our BETA testing to experience avatar system and the new war system
notes.content:
Amenders:

We have received a lot of feedback since the release of Lightracer Spark, and we would like to sincerely thank you all. Many of them are discussions about the combat system, believing that the current combat operations are too cumbersome and inconsistent with the perspective of advanced civilization. To this end, we have reworked the combat system and added a new "AVATAR" system, hoping to make the combat experience more in line with the amenders' expectations.

At present, this content has been initially developed. Next, we want to work with the amenders to make the new version of the combat experience more perfect. So we plan to start beta testing before the official version is updated. Beta testing is open to everyone, and interested amenders can switch to the corresponding branch to experience it. There will inevitably be experience deficiencies or bugs in the Beta test version. We would like to apologize to you in advance, and please fully understand this possibility before switching branches to experience it.

[h2]Note[/h2]
1. Participating players must own the Lightracer Spark to enter the test branch.
2. The archives of the test branch is independent from the archives of the main game and do not interfere with each other. That is to say, the test branch needs to play the game from the beginning. Therefore, after you switch back to the main game branch, the game progress of the previous main game will be saved and will not be affected.

[h2]How to enter test branch[/h2]
Right-click Lightracer Spark in the library → click Properties → click Betas → enter the test branch code [i][b]zhuguangBeta[/b][/i] in the private betas column → click Check Code to enter the branch and the game will automatically update → enter the game after the update is completed.

[h2]Introduction to the avatar system[/h2]
Play as the Amender, descending directly into the world in the form of an avatar, issuing instructions to destroy the enemy or strengthen your own army and jurisdiction.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43121297/2a0d164012fa6d6facde5d8c35ec030526fb484d.png[/img]

[h2]War system remake[/h2]
The Beta version replaces the previous war system, hoping to reduce cumbersome operations and change the overall game experience.
The new version of the war system focuses on the operation of avatars and special troops. The operation methods of the above two are similar to the old version, but they can move forward to any jurisdiction on the same planet without restrictions.
The conventional army will be modified to a control method in the form of issuing orders. You no longer need to directly control each army. Instead, you can assemble the army after choosing a war strategy. The conventional army will complete the combat mission according to your deployment.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43121297/4737974cec97b9784479fd4a907da274841ff574.png[/img]
Four types and more than 30 avatar commands
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43121297/79d56e876f26207906c4d7f6daf21563f6ad3bfd.png[/img]
Three different avatar forms
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43121297/2643f3697f5b28fda114f93ddad4d39f219adc7b.png[/img]
Your avatar can be born from the prologue, so the story of Tien has changed slightly.
Avatars have level settings. After investing basic resources, you can upgrade the level and unlock exclusive instructions for the current form.
Most commands can be upgraded to improve their effectiveness, but require special resources from the warehouse.

[h2]Attention[/h2]
[list]
[*] The test is open to everyone from now on and is expected to end before the release of DLC2
[*] Please do not copy and overwrite the BETA test archives to the main game archive directory!
[*] When the official version has the avatar system, some content may be adjusted.
[*] Tell us what you think. You can let us know your feedback or suggestions through the following methods
[/list]
Feedback link：https://www.wjx.top/vm/eBmqN8E.aspx#
Official Discord：https://discord.gg/SzvGbBcKuC     DM our staff

notes.title: Lightracer Spark official release announcement & Fan-fiction event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43121297/737c7bc0bf521703ffd39331a971dafc83dc55a1.jpg[/img]
Sci-fi narrative indie game "Lightracer Spark" is officially released on Steam now.

We have started an event of fan creation works, the themes are as follows:


In real life, new technologies such as artificial intelligence, nanomaterials, and controllable nuclear fusion are accelerating changes to our planet. The Originium civilization in the first chapter of "Chasing Light and Spark" is a world that is more advanced than reality and has completed the fourth industrial revolution. On this planet, people use brain-computer interfaces to assist in scientific research, wear exoskeletons to go to the battlefield, construct large rings that can surround the planet, and gradually step into the starry sky after leaving the baby of the parent star.
Please combine the background settings of the game to create a work about space, virtual reality and general artificial intelligence that takes place on Originium Star.


1. Participation method: Post your creation on any social platform or website that can be seen by official personnel, and then fill in the link in the official collection questionnaire to be considered participation. Submission link: wjx.top/vm/YalQQBJ.aspx (please copy and open it in your browser）


2. Submission form: The creation form of submission can include text, art, animation, video clips, movies, games, etc.


3. Prize setting: 
Special prize: Choose one from following 3 consoles, Sony Play Station 5 console with a controller, Microsoft Xbox Series X console with a controller, Nintendo NS console (OLED version) with red and blue Joy-Con.  
First prize: XBOX Elite Wireless Controller Series 2.  
Second prizes: Amazon.sg eGift Card $58.   
Third prize: Amazon.sg eGift Card $15 


4. Time: The event will start on April 12, 2023 and end on July 17, 2023. The staff will spend 3-5 days to make statistics. After the selection by the production team, the final winners will be announced on the official platforms of Lightracer Spark.


Notice:
1. Smartmelon  Games has the right to use the secondary dissemination of all entries.
2. If it is found to use other people's secondary creations to enter the competition, it will be disqualified from the selection
3. Secondary creations with illegal or malicious content will not be able to participate in the selection
4. The materials used in the selected works must not infringe, otherwise the qualification will be disqualified
5. Smartmelon Games has the right to interpret this activity within the scope prescribed by law.


Welcome to join our official [url=https://discord.gg/SzvGbBcKuC]Discord[/url] communicate with Devs and other players, and get first-hand game-related information.

notes.title: V1.25 Happy Chinese Lunar New Year "Lightracer Spark" free DEMO update
notes.content:
Amenders, long time no see. We have collected your feedback, and made a small update on the occasion of the Chinese New Year.

The update content is as follows:

·Added a section of the main story [HEROES OF THE BADLANDS] in the [ORIGINIUM] chapter, which mainly depicts the story of a pilot named Simon Zuider who changed his hometown after being inspired by the Amender.

·Added a billing system, now you can check your own monthly fixed income and expenditure

·Added the function of resetting the initial points

·Added the ability to customize role names

·Added shortcut keys such as ESC to exit full screen

·According to the feedback from the first demo version, the guidance logic of the prologue has been optimized

·Fixed the BUG of the black screen after choosing the Path of the Corrector

·Fixed the situation where some models got stuck on the story illustration screen after entering the game

·Adapted to some widescreen resolutions

·Fixed some UI garbled characters

·some systematic comprehensive optimization

*special note*
At present, the demo version is still in the continuous development stage, and the archive is not compatible with the subsequent version and the Final official version.
Players who have tried the DEMO before, need to restart the ORIGINIUM chapter in the [Chapter] interface of the main menu to play the new content.
If you want to quickly pass through the content you have already played, you can adjust the text playback speed in [Settings].
Thank you so much!

If you encounter problems in the game, or want to discuss the game content with more friends, welcome to join the official discord：https://discord.gg/SzvGbBcKuC

Wish all the amenders a happy Chinese lunar new year！
